description: One record per distinct, evidence-backed problem. Write an array of these.

fields.domain: string, one of the 12 research domains or 'wildcard'
fields.title: short problem title (not a product name)
fields.job_to_be_done: the specific task they need to accomplish
fields.failure_frequency: how often (per user, per year, etc.) with source if available; else 'unknown'
fields.cost_of_failure: time or money lost, with source if supportable; else 'unknown'
fields.existing_workaround: what people do today to cope
fields.who_pays_today: who currently spends money on this (vendors, consultants, staff time, etc.)
fields.firsthand_evidence: a brief paraphrase of a real firsthand complaint if found (NO fabricated quotes; paraphrase only unless the exact short phrase came from a search result)
fields.key_unknowns: what we do not know that matters
fields.technical_unlock: what capability (new or existing) could make this solvable now; be specific; 'none obvious' is acceptable
fields.why_now: what changed in the last 12-24 months that matters, if anything
fields.existing_solutions: known vendors/products/open-source attempting it, if any
fields.verification_status: VERIFIED | INFERRED | ASSUMED (apply to the core claim that the problem exists at scale)
